explanation: The statement is entirely about the library's own QuantumSet construction: `Psi`, `tenSwap`, `rmul`, `k`, `n`, `onb`, `QuantumSet.inner_modAut_right_conj`, etc. Searches in Mathlib for `tenSwap`, `Psi`, `rmul` (other than the unrelated Jordan-algebra `lmul_comm_rmul`/`rmul_comm_rmul_rmul` axioms) and in the library for these definitions show they are defined in LeanPool/Monlib4/LinearAlgebra/QuantumSet/Basic.lean (e.g. `Psi` at line 434, `rmul` used at line 331), not in Mathlib. Mathlib has no notion of a quantum set or of a modular conjugation/swap operator of this form, so there is no declaration stating this result or from which it follows in one or two lines.
